notes: 14 synthetic causes across the five FIT HANU campus IT support domains (hanu_wifi, fit_lms, lab_computers, hanu_account, fit_printer). Not real incident causes.

causes.description: HANU_Student captive portal session has expired or cookie is blocked by the browser
causes.recommended_action: Clear browser cookies and cache, then reconnect to HANU_Student and open a non-HTTPS page to trigger the portal redirect.

causes.description: Wireless adapter driver on the laptop is outdated or incompatible with the campus AP firmware
causes.recommended_action: Update or reinstall the wireless network adapter driver from the manufacturer's website.

causes.description: Campus access point in Nhà C is overloaded or malfunctioning (too many concurrent clients)
causes.recommended_action: Report to FIT Office (P.210 Nhà C) and try connecting from a different location or access point.

causes.description: Student has not been enrolled in the course section on FIT LMS after credit registration
causes.recommended_action: Contact the course instructor or FIT Office (P.210 Nhà C) to request manual LMS enrollment.

causes.description: FIT LMS session timeout is set too short, or the browser is blocking the keep-alive cookie
causes.recommended_action: Use a supported browser (Chrome/Firefox), disable strict cookie blocking, and stay on the LMS tab.

causes.description: Submission file exceeds the FIT LMS upload size limit (usually 50 MB per file)
causes.recommended_action: Compress the submission into a smaller archive, or split into multiple files, and re-submit.

causes.description: GRUB bootloader is misconfigured on the lab workstation (dual-boot Ubuntu/Windows issue)
causes.recommended_action: Report to Lab technician or FIT Office; do not attempt to repair GRUB manually in a shared lab machine.

causes.description: Lab workstation LAN cable is unplugged from the switch or the NIC has failed
causes.recommended_action: Check the cable connection at the back of the workstation; report a failed NIC to the lab technician.

causes.description: Projector input source is not set to the correct HDMI port, or the HDMI cable is faulty
causes.recommended_action: Press SOURCE on the projector remote and select HDMI; try a different cable.

causes.description: HANU student account password has expired (HANU policy requires periodic password changes)
causes.recommended_action: Use the HANU self-service password reset portal or visit FIT Office (P.210 Nhà C) with student ID.

causes.description: HANU account is locked after exceeding the maximum number of failed login attempts
causes.recommended_action: Wait 30 minutes for auto-unlock, or contact FIT Office (P.210 Nhà C / fit@hanu.edu.vn) for manual unlock.

causes.description: Microsoft 365 HANU licence is not assigned to the account, or licence pool is temporarily exhausted
causes.recommended_action: Report to FIT Office; the licence assignment may need to be refreshed from the admin portal.

causes.description: Shared printer driver in P.210 Nhà C is missing or mismatched with the student's OS version
causes.recommended_action: Install the correct driver from the HANU intranet printer page, or ask staff in P.210.

causes.description: Printer toner cartridge in P.210 is empty or the printer has an uncleared paper jam sensor
causes.recommended_action: Report to FIT Office; staff will replace toner or physically clear the jam sensor flag.
